'''January 2001 Framingham tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Video Connection, Framingham, MA on 6 January 2001. [[Hayes Hunter]] won it. It is known from Hayes Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1597">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-07-framingham-ma-1-6-01d1597/ framingham-ma-1-6-01], DeckTech (Hayes "Hayes" Hunter, 7 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-07-framingham-ma-1-6-01d1597/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 6 January 2001
* '''Site:''' Video Connection, Framingham, MA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 26
* '''Winner:''' [[Hayes Hunter]]
